title: Pelican Trace
meta_description: Private Pool, Gulf & State Park Views- Pelican Trace by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Pelican Trace by Royal Destinations Location: Grayton Beach Address: 174 Savelle Drive Details: Pelican Trace is a luxurious 4,250-square-foot home located in the private Gulf Trace community of Grayton Beach, with an additional 2,416 square feet of outdoor living space. Accommodating up to 8 guests, this beautifully appointed retreat features four King en-suite bedrooms, four full baths, two half baths, and sophisticated interiors with high-end finishes throughout. Multiple covered and screened porches showcase glimpses of the Gulf and surrounding Grayton Beach State Park, while spacious living and dining areas provide an inviting setting for families and friends to gather. Outdoors, a private fenced backyard backs directly up to Grayton Beach State Park and features a 17' x 30' saltwater pool, spacious lawn, and plenty of room to relax. Guests are just a short walk from either of Gulf Trace's two private neighborhood beach accesses, with only six homes between Pelican Trace and the sand. Surrounded by Grayton Beach State Park, Gulf Trace offers access to approximately one mile of beautiful, undisturbed shoreline. From alfresco dining overlooking the pool to Gulf glimpses from the upper-level porches, Pelican Trace combines privacy, luxury, and an exceptional Grayton Beach location. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: Short Walk to Private Neighborhood Beach Access -Parking Spaces: (4) in Driveway -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 8, Bar Seating for 4, Outdoor Dining for 8 -Coffee Maker Available: Drip Coffee Maker -Private Saltwater Pool: 17' x 30' (Not Heated) -Private Fenced Backyard -Backs Up to Grayton Beach State Park -Gulf and State Park Views -(2) Screened Porches -(3) Covered Porches -Wet Bar with Beverage Refrigerator -(2) Laundry Areas -Outdoor Gas Grill -Enclosed Outdoor Shower Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 8 4 Bedrooms / 4 Full Baths / 2 Half Baths First Floor: -Foyer -Half Bath -Laundry Room -Enclosed Outdoor Shower -Screened Porch with Beverage Refrigerator Second Floor: -Bedroom 1: King Bed with Private Bath (Walk-In Shower, Dual Vanities, Water Closet) -Living Room / Kitchen / Dining Area -Half Bath -Covered Balcony with Gulf Glimpses -Screened Porch with Outdoor Dining for 8 Overlooking Pool Third Floor: -Bedroom 2: King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub, Walk-In Shower, Dual Vanities, Water Closet), Vaulted Ceiling, Custom Closet, Gulf Glimpse and Covered Porch Overlooking Pool -Bedroom 3: King Bed with Private Bath (Tub/Shower, Double Vanity), Vaulted Ceiling -Bedroom 4: King Bed with Private Bath (Walk-In Shower, Double Vanity), Vaulted Ceiling -Wet Bar with Beverage Refrigerator -Laundry Room with Utility Sink -Covered Balconies Please Note: *The private saltwater pool is not heated. *LSVs and on-street parking are prohibited within the Gulf Trace neighborhood. *The garage is not accessible to guests. *The living room fireplace is decorative only and is not available for guest use. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
